title: I Ran A Frontier AI On My Own Laptop For Free
description:
Alibaba released Qwen3.8-27B on 14 August 2026 under Apache 2.0. It is a 27 billion parameter vision model with 262K context that runs on a single consumer graphics card, and it is genuinely free including for commercial use.

The setup is LM Studio, a free desktop app for Windows, Mac and Linux that checks your hardware and tells you which quantized version will actually load. Q4_K_M is around 18 GB and suits a 24 GB card; a ridge-quantized build fits the whole model on 16 GB. Everything runs offline, so private documents never leave your machine.

Get the full setup guide here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1olfB25i2qOOMvyMa9zDyyy_5AOk1hlNnCmp-9lMTVPI/edit?usp=sharing
